normative_extracts.quote: A SharedArrayBuffer represents a fixed-length raw binary data buffer that can be referenced concurrently by multiple agents via TypedArray views and synchronized using Atomics.

browser_support.notes: Requires crossOriginIsolated === true (COOP + COEP headers) since Spectre mitigations.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Multiple JS isolates map the same virtual memory pages and coordinate reads/writes using CPU atomic instructions and OS futex queues.

production_failures.symptom: ReferenceError: SharedArrayBuffer is not defined in production despite working on localhost
production_failures.root_cause: Missing Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin and Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp response headers on the document.
production_failures.mitigation: Serve COOP/COEP headers on the HTML document and verify window.crossOriginIsolated before constructing SharedArrayBuffer.

production_failures.symptom: Main thread freezes indefinitely with Uncaught TypeError: Atomics.wait cannot be called in this context
production_failures.root_cause: Calling blocking Atomics.wait() on the browser main thread, which the spec forbids to prevent UI deadlocks.
production_failures.mitigation: Use Atomics.wait() only inside workers, or use Atomics.waitAsync() on the main thread.
